name: genre-orchestrator
description: Load and fold a requested genre/style into an active H3 (or image) prompt. Use when a request names or clearly signals a style/genre and it must be woven into the prompt fields. Loads exactly the matching genre-* skill, picks one dominant family (plus at most one secondary), and splices its Style reference block into the prompt. Do NOT use for translating a genre doc into a genre skill (genre-compiler) or for writing the pre-prompt shot plan (dev-director).
